children: Foreign investors Accion International, LeapFrog Financial, Eight Roads, and Augusta Investments sold a combined 13.12 percent stake in non-banking finance company Northern Arc Capital through open-market transactions on August 31.

According to block deal data on the BSE, LeapFrog Financial Inclusion India (II), owned by UK-based private equity firm LeapFrog Investments, offloaded 46.47 lakh shares, equivalent to a 2.87 percent stake in Northern Arc Capital, for Rs 129.18 crore.

Fidelity-backed Eight Roads Investments Mauritius II offloaded 85.96 lakh shares, representing a 5.31 percent stake, for Rs 238.96 crore, while Augusta Investments II, owned by emerging markets-focused private equity firm Affirma Capital, sold 23.38 lakh shares, or a 1.44 percent stake, for Rs 65 crore.
Further, Accion International subsidiary Accion Africa-Asia Investment Company sold 56.32 lakh shares, representing a 3.48 percent stake, for Rs 156.57 crore.

Meanwhile, Societe Generale, Plutus Wealth Management, Cohesion MK Best Ideas Sub-Trust, Neo Prime Fund, Ashoka India Equity Investment Trust, India Acorn Fund, Adivam Family Trust, S Gupta Homes, Shubhi Consultancy Services, and Singularity Equity Fund I bought all 2.12 crore shares, representing the 13.12 percent stake sold by LeapFrog Financial, Eight Roads, Accion Africa, and Augusta Investments, at a price of Rs 278 per share.

According to the June 2026 shareholding pattern, LeapFrog Financial Inclusion India (II) held a 16.15 percent stake in Northern Arc Capital, while Eight Roads Investments Mauritius II held 6.87 percent, Augusta Investments II held 16.02 percent, and Accion Africa held 3.98 percent.

Arpit Khandelwal-led Plutus Wealth Management LLP acquired 38.66 lakh shares in Northern Arc Capital for Rs 107.5 crore, while Cohesion MK Best Ideas Sub-Trust, a joint venture between Cohesion Asset Management and market veteran Madhusudan Kela, acquired 48.74 lakh shares for Rs 135.5 crore.
Singularity Equity Fund I was also a shareholder in Northern Arc Capital, holding a 1.15 percent stake as of June 2026.
Northern Arc Capital shares surged 9.06 percent following a breakout from consolidation, closing at Rs 311.65 amid heavy volumes on the National Stock Exchange.

title: Accion International, Leapfrog, Eight Roads, Augusta Investments offload over 13% stake in Northern Arc Capital
